sys.architectural_pattern: Workspace of independently versioned packages published to GitHub Packages

sprint.goal: Repo kit + docs + published @gokulsaraswat/ui v0.1 (tokens + footer), installable from another repo.
done: Step 1: repo kit (CLAUDE.md, README, ARCHITECTURE, CONTRACTS, LICENSE all-rights-reserved, SECURITY, .gitignore, .env.example, PR template), npm workspace root, Changesets init; scope renamed @gokul -> @gokulsaraswat (GitHub Packages scope must equal owner).

Step 2: packages/ui with tokens.css (bestportofolio colors/radius, Tailwind 4.3.3 type/shadows, Progress motion; durations = range midpoints) + tailwind.css mapping; 4 node:test checks; root build/lint/test scripts; .github/workflows/ci.yml; graphify-out generated; changeset (ui minor). Verified: npm test 4/4, Tailwind 4.3.3 compile in scratch dir. graphify hook install NOT run (blocked; owner runs it).

Step 3: React Footer (siteName, tagline, basePath, columns, socials, linkComponent, year; fixed 9-link legal row) + LegalPage (marked placeholder) + footerPages/pagePath; styles.css (gk- classes, tokens only); TypeScript 6.0 build to dist, ESLint 10 + typescript-eslint; 10 node:test tests incl. SSR render. Verified: build ok, lint clean, 10/10 tests, browser check light/dark desktop/mobile (fixed invalid grid -> flex). TS pinned ~6.0 because typescript-eslint supports <6.1.

Step 4: .github/workflows/release.yml (main: lint, test, changeset publish to GitHub Packages with GITHUB_TOKEN, push tags); changeset version -> @gokulsaraswat/ui 0.1.0 + CHANGELOG. Versioned locally so no 'Actions can create PRs' setting is needed.

Step 5: .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml (after Release + manual): installs published @gokulsaraswat/ui into a scratch consumer with GITHUB_TOKEN, renders Footer, resolves CSS exports, tsc type-check. Verified: run 41202858931, all steps success.

todo_next.item: GitHub settings: description, topics, branch protection on main (gh CLI not installed; owner runs commands at the end if needed).
Scaffold @gokulsaraswat/mdx, /auth, /config once their contracts are defined in docs/CONTRACTS.md.
